blurb: Warren Pies is co-founder and strategist at 3Fourteen Research, an independent macro research firm known for systematic, data-driven market analysis. Previously a strategist at Ned Davis Research, he focuses on equities, fixed income, energy markets, and asset allocation. On X he shares macro charts, cycle analysis, and market commentary oriented toward institutional and serious retail investors.
credibility_note: Generally regarded as a rigorous, data-first analyst with a quantitative bent; no major public corrections or controversies in the record through mid-2025. Research is subscription-based, so full methodology is behind a paywall.
